data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 3/5): Pin shared-state contract — env var DSO_TELEMETRY_LEDGER_DIR; files event-id-map.json + event-id-map.lock + submitted.log all under that dir. Add 12th test test_idempotency_dedup_by_event_id: invoke twice with same forced event_id; mock server receives exactly ONE POST + submitted.log contains event_id once. Without this test, story DD 'Idempotency' has zero behavioral coverage.
